title: AgentCtl Config
description: Configuration for agentctl — the single source of truth for AI coding-agent settings. Lives at .ai/config.yaml.

project.description: Project metadata used in generated file headers.

name.description: Project name used in generated file headers.

extends.description: Optional base policy to inherit from. May be an HTTPS URL, an npm package path (@scope/pkg/permissions.yaml), or a local file path. Local permissions are merged on top and can only tighten, never weaken, the inherited policy.

runtimes.description: Which AI coding-agent runtimes to generate configuration for. Any runtime omitted here defaults to disabled.

claude.description: Optional Claude Code specific settings. Omitted fields fall back to defaults.

alwaysThinkingEnabled.description: Enable Claude's always-on thinking mode. Default: true.

cleanupPeriodDays.description: Number of days before Claude cleans up chat transcripts. Default: 90.

disableTelemetry.description: Disable Claude Code telemetry. Default: true.

sync.description: Which categories of configuration agentctl sync should generate.

mcp.description: Generate runtime MCP server configs from .ai/mcp.yaml. Default: false.

instructions.description: Generate runtime instruction files from .ai/instructions.md. Default: false.

files.description: Paths to the runtime-neutral source files.

permissions.description: Path to the permissions source file (e.g. .ai/permissions.yaml).

mcp.description: Path to the MCP source file (e.g. .ai/mcp.yaml).

instructions.description: Path to the instructions source file (e.g. .ai/instructions.md).

enabled.description: Whether agentctl generates configuration for this runtime.
